summary: First full-stack QA pass on Meraaj Network (Arabic RTL B2B Umrah marketplace). Backend: created pytest regression suite (33 tests, 27 passed = 82%) covering auth/JWT/bcrypt/cookies, packages CRUD+market filters, full booking lifecycle blue->yellow->green with exact escrow math, visa validation, 24h settlement block, blue & yellow cancellations, disputes + admin resolution, wallet topup/P2P/withdrawal approval flows, office suspend/activate, and Rahal integration (API key + HMAC webhooks). Frontend: verified admin dashboard/liquidity, office register+login, wallet cards, package creation, market filters/search, booking with correct debit (2000 net + 40 platform fee = 2040), blue cancel refund (1000), full yellow cancel negotiation (deduction 250 -> refund 770), dispatch, settlement-blocked toast, dispute open + admin release_seller, finance approvals (topup/transfer), suspend/activate. Found 3 CRITICAL money-safety state-guard bugs in backend, a broken main-content layout offset (content hidden under the fixed sidebar on every page), and no handling of 403 for suspended offices.

critical.issue: cancel-request has no guard for status 'cancelled' (only blocks 'green'). An already-cancelled booking can be pushed back into the yellow cancellation flow and refunded a SECOND time. Reproduced: buyer starts with 10000, books 1020, cancels (blue refund), replays cancel-request -> cancel-offer(0) -> cancel-accept and ends with 11000 (i.e. ~1000 created out of thin air; seller pending also goes negative and seats are released twice).

No idempotency/state guard — a resolved dispute (dispute.status == 'resolved' / settled == true) can be resolved again, crediting the buyer (or seller) each time. Reproduced: buyer balance went 10000 -> 11020 after resolving the same dispute twice.

A second dispute POST on a booking with an already-open dispute returns 200 and overwrites the existing dispute (reason/opener/created_at lost). Also missing the spec's 'within 24h of dispatch' window check — a dispute can be opened any time while status is green.

minor.issue: Malformed ObjectId returns 500 (bson.errors.InvalidId leaks from oid()). Should be 400/404. Wrap oid() in try/except across market.py/wallet.py/admin.py.
No brute-force protection: 6+ consecutive wrong passwords all return 401, no lockout/throttle (playbook requires lockout after 5 failures).
Seat/balance check and the wallet debit are not atomic (read-then-$inc). Two concurrent bookings can oversell seats or overdraw available balance. Use findOneAndUpdate with a conditional filter.

visa_file is unconditionally overwritten with v.get('visa_file') (None when omitted), so a previously stored visa file is wiped on re-submit. Also partial payload mutates the in-memory list only, so nothing persists — behaviour is correct today but fragile.

Platform fee is charged twice per booking: buyer is debited net + 10% of buyer commission, and at settlement the seller receives net - the same fee. Confirm this double-take is intended; the spec describes a single 10% platform fee.

ui_bugs.issue: Main content uses `me-72` (margin-inline-END) while the sidebar is fixed at inline-START, so all page content is offset to the wrong side and slides UNDER the sidebar. Measured on /dashboard @1920: sidebar.left=1632 but h1.right=1648 -> page titles are clipped on every screen (dashboard, sales, bookings, market, admin). Fix: `ms-72` instead of `me-72`.

Sidebar is always `fixed w-72` with no mobile drawer/hamburger. At 390px the document scrollWidth is 556px (horizontal overflow) and the content sits behind the sidebar — the app is unusable on mobile.

After an admin suspends an office, every office API call returns 403 but the UI shows normal pages with misleading empty states (e.g. 'لا توجد مبيعات بعد') and no message; unhandled axios rejections trigger the CRA 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay. Add a global 403 interceptor -> Arabic 'حسابك موقوف' screen / forced logout.

data-testid is built from the Arabic title: `wallet-balance-الرصيد المتاح` / `wallet-balance-الرصيد المعلق (ضمان)`. Unstable, non-ASCII testids; only the gold card has `wallet-balance-total`. Use total/pending/available.
Office table has no email column and no search/pagination — 36 offices are rendered with no way to identify an office by email (admin identifies offices by email everywhere else, e.g. P2P transfers).
Search only fires on Enter (no debounce, no search button); typing appears to do nothing, which reads as a broken filter.

issues: Page heading and the first stat/wallet card are partially hidden behind the fixed sidebar due to the me-72/ms-72 mistake
Large empty area on the opposite side of the viewport because content is pushed to the wrong side
No responsive sidebar, horizontal page overflow (556px content in a 390px viewport)

action_items: CRITICAL: add status guards to cancel-request/cancel-offer/cancel-accept (reject when status is 'cancelled' or when cancellation already settled) — currently allows double refund / money creation
CRITICAL: make admin dispute resolution idempotent (reject when dispute.status != 'open' or settled == true)
HIGH: reject duplicate dispute creation and enforce the 24h-from-dispatch dispute window
HIGH: change `me-72` to `ms-72` in components/Layout.js and add a mobile sidebar (drawer + hamburger)
HIGH: handle 403 responses globally (suspended office) with an Arabic message / forced logout instead of empty pages + runtime-error overlay
MEDIUM: wrap ObjectId parsing so malformed ids return 400/404 instead of 500
MEDIUM: add login rate limiting / lockout after 5 failed attempts
MEDIUM: make booking seat+balance debit atomic (conditional findOneAndUpdate) and use stable ASCII data-testids in Wallet.js
LOW: add email column + search to admin offices; trigger market search on typing (debounced) or add a search button
Clarify whether the platform fee should be charged to both buyer and seller (currently taken twice per booking)
critical_code_review_comments: market.py cancel-request/cancel-accept and admin.py resolve_dispute perform wallet $inc without any terminal-state check — every money-moving endpoint needs an idempotency guard (e.g. conditional update on status) to prevent replay-driven balance inflation
db.oid() raises bson.InvalidId which surfaces as HTTP 500 on every endpoint that accepts an id path param
create_booking reads wallet/seats then writes with $inc — race condition allows overselling and overdraft; use a single conditional update
Layout.js main margin uses the wrong logical side (me-72 vs ms-72), which breaks the layout of every authenticated page

rca_of_the_issue: The money-safety bugs share one root cause: state transitions in market.py/admin.py validate only a subset of statuses before mutating wallets with $inc, and there is no terminal-state/idempotency flag check. cancel-request only rejects status=='green', so a 'cancelled' booking still enters the yellow negotiation branch and cancel-accept re-credits the buyer and re-releases seats; resolve_dispute only checks that a dispute object exists, so it can be replayed after 'resolved'. The layout bug is a logical-property mistake: the sidebar is positioned at inline-start (start-0) while <main> reserves space with margin-inline-end (me-72), so in RTL the reserved gap lands on the opposite side and content renders beneath the sidebar.
